senses.zh_definition: Bablu：可用作人名的专名；尚未核实小写 bablu 具有马来语普通词义。
senses.en_definition: Bablu, a personal name; no Malay common-word sense has been verified for the supplied lowercase form.
senses.ms_definition: Bablu ialah nama khas orang; makna sebagai kata umum bahasa Melayu belum disahkan.
senses.nuances: 此处为有文献依据的专名用法说明，非 DBP 官方释义。沙巴环境保护局报告的摄影署名出现 Bablu Virinder Singh，证明其可作人名，但不能据此确定输入词项的原始指称、词源或读音。下列组合为教学示例，未认定为高频搭配。依据：[沙巴环境指标报告](https://epd.sabah.gov.my/v3/wp-content/uploads/2022/11/13-01-indi1.pdf)。

etymology.historical_story: Bablu appears as part of a photographer's name in a Sabah government environmental report, showing how personal names enter Malaysian documentary records. That occurrence establishes a naming use, not a Malay vocabulary meaning. The packet supplies no origin or pronunciation, so neither a historical derivation nor a standardized Malay reading can responsibly be assigned.
